greeting: Hi! I'm Riley, the virtual assistant for Bluebonnet Heating & Air. Is your AC or heater acting up, or can I help you schedule maintenance?
hours: Monday-Friday 7 AM-6 PM, Saturday 8 AM-2 PM. 24/7 emergency service.

service_area.description: Austin, Round Rock, Pflugerville, Cedar Park and Georgetown

services.name: AC repair
services.description: Diagnosis and repair of central AC, heat pumps and mini-splits, all major brands.

services.name: Heating repair
services.description: Gas furnaces, electric furnaces and heat pumps.

services.name: Maintenance tune-up
services.description: Seasonal AC or furnace tune-up: cleaning, refrigerant check, electrical and safety inspection.

services.name: New system installation
services.description: Free in-home estimate for replacing AC, furnace or heat pump systems.

services.name: Indoor air quality
services.description: Filters, UV lights, humidifiers and duct cleaning.

pricing.diagnostic_fee: $89 service call, waived if the customer approves the repair
pricing.tune_up: $119 per system; members of the Comfort Club get 2 tune-ups per year included
notes: Repair prices depend on the diagnosis; the technician gives an upfront written price before any work starts.
Never quote a repair or installation total in chat.

financing: Financing available for new systems, with approved credit; the comfort advisor explains options during the estimate.
warranties: 1-year labor warranty on repairs; 10-year parts and labor on new installations when registered.

emergency.examples: No heat when it is below 40°F, no AC when it is above 95°F with a baby, elderly or medically fragile person at home, water leaking from the unit onto ceilings or floors.
emergency.on_call_response: The on-call technician is notified and calls back within 15 minutes.

faqs.a: All major brands, including Trane, Carrier, Lennox, Goodman, Rheem and Daikin.
Yes, licensed by the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation and fully insured.

faqs.q: Do you offer a maintenance plan?
faqs.a: Yes, the Comfort Club: $15/month, two tune-ups per year, priority scheduling and 15% off repairs.

faqs.q: How long does a repair visit take?
faqs.a: Most repairs take 1-2 hours once the technician arrives.
